title: エルムSの後に・わたし、がんばる

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Defeated, Haru Urara urges me to take her back to the dorms immediately for more training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition, she says she wants to enter more G1 races, and, well, who am I to ignore such a request?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So I decide to enter her in the JBC Sprint because she excels at sprints on a dirt course.
